database.cars_schema:
CREATE TABLE cars (
            id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            brand         TEXT,
            model         TEXT,
            year          TEXT,
            vin           TEXT,
            fuel          TEXT,
            engine        TEXT,
            color         TEXT,
            mileage       TEXT,
            trim          TEXT,
            condition     TEXT,
            accidents     TEXT,
            auction_link  TEXT,
            price_buy     TEXT,
            price_extra   TEXT,
            price_ship    TEXT,
            price_customs TEXT,
            price_total   TEXT,
            stage         TEXT,               -- этап доставки
            photos        TEXT,               -- JSON-список file_id
            videos        TEXT,
            docs          TEXT,
            responsible   INTEGER,
            review_status TEXT NOT NULL,      -- статус согласования
            published     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- виден ли в клиентском боте
            created_by    INTEGER,
            approved_by   INTEGER,
            created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at    TEXT
        , client_id INTEGER, publish_pending INTEGER DEFAULT 0, video_h TEXT, video_v TEXT, auto_number TEXT, engine_cc INTEGER, gearbox TEXT, drive TEXT, mileage_km INTEGER, condition_text TEXT, condition_photos TEXT, condition_videos TEXT, diag_report TEXT, diag_link TEXT, kr_buy_date TEXT, kr_parking TEXT, sea_container TEXT, sea_port_from TEXT, sea_date_out TEXT, ge_port TEXT, ge_arrived TEXT, ge_released TEXT, days_to_kyiv TEXT, ua_delivered TEXT, ua_handed TEXT, cost_purchase INTEGER, cost_fees INTEGER, cost_logistics INTEGER, cost_total TEXT, price_uah INTEGER, nbu_rate TEXT, status TEXT, owner_user TEXT, history TEXT, price_history TEXT, cover_photo TEXT, eta_manual TEXT, description TEXT, hidden_photos TEXT, diag_text TEXT, ge_to_kyiv_at TEXT, price_georgia INTEGER)

triggers.name: media_st_v
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER media_st_v BEFORE INSERT ON media WHEN NEW.status NOT IN ('pending','ready','rejected','quarantine') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'недопустимый статус'); END

triggers.name: media_st_p
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER media_st_p BEFORE UPDATE ON media WHEN NEW.status NOT IN ('pending','ready','rejected','quarantine') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'недопустимый статус'); END

triggers.name: media_vid_v
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER media_vid_v BEFORE INSERT ON media WHEN NEW.vid NOT IN ('foto','video','diag_foto','diag_video','diag_dok') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'недопустимый вид'); END

triggers.name: media_mash
triggers.sql: CREATE TRIGGER media_mash BEFORE INSERT ON media WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cars WHERE id=NEW.car_id)=0 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'нет такой машины'); END
